acceptance_criteria: All unmapped API_LOCAL connections classified by official mapping availability
Name hints not treated as authoritative

queries.name: api_local_unmapped_current_state
queries.sql: SELECT sc.nombre, CONVERT(nvarchar(100), sc.id) AS connection_id, sc.tipo_conexion, sc.system_type, sc.activo, sc.visible_en_operaciones, sc.visible_en_listado, sc.EmpresaID, sc.empresa_id AS legacy_empresa_id_text FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones AS sc WHERE sc.tipo_conexion = 'API_LOCAL' AND sc.EmpresaID IS NULL ORDER BY sc.activo DESC, sc.visible_en_operaciones DESC, sc.nombre

queries.name: candidate_mapping_table_schemas
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, IS_NULLABLE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME IN ('Sistema_Empresas', 'Sistema_EmpresasAlias', 'Sistema_EmpresasMongoMap', 'Sistema_EmpresasServidores', 'Sistema_Sucursales', 'Servidores_Conexiones', 'Unidades_Negocio', 'Usuario_ServidoresAsignacion') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: sistema_empresas_alias_rows
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 300 * FROM dbo.Sistema_EmpresasAlias ORDER BY 1

queries.name: sistema_empresas_mongo_map_rows
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 300 * FROM dbo.Sistema_EmpresasMongoMap ORDER BY 1

queries.name: sistema_sucursales_rows
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 300 * FROM dbo.Sistema_Sucursales ORDER BY 1

queries.name: unidades_negocio_linked_by_api_local_connection_id
queries.sql: WITH ApiLocal AS (SELECT id, nombre FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones WHERE tipo_conexion = 'API_LOCAL' AND EmpresaID IS NULL) SELECT a.nombre, CONVERT(nvarchar(100), a.id) AS connection_id, CONVERT(nvarchar(100), u.id) AS unidad_negocio_id, CONVERT(nvarchar(100), u.server_id) AS unidad_server_id, CONVERT(nvarchar(100), u.sucursal_origen_id) AS sucursal_origen_id, u.activo AS unidad_activa FROM ApiLocal AS a LEFT JOIN dbo.Unidades_Negocio AS u ON LOWER(CONVERT(nvarchar(100), u.server_id)) = LOWER(CONVERT(nvarchar(100), a.id)) ORDER BY a.nombre, u.activo DESC

queries.name: usuario_servidores_assignments_for_unmapped_api_local
queries.sql: WITH ApiLocal AS (SELECT id, nombre FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones WHERE tipo_conexion = 'API_LOCAL' AND EmpresaID IS NULL) SELECT a.nombre, CONVERT(nvarchar(100), a.id) AS connection_id, usa.UsuarioID, uc.Email, usa.Activo AS asignacion_activa FROM ApiLocal AS a LEFT JOIN dbo.Usuario_ServidoresAsignacion AS usa ON LOWER(CONVERT(nvarchar(100), usa.ServidorID)) = LOWER(CONVERT(nvarchar(100), a.id)) LEFT JOIN dbo.Usuario_Catalogo AS uc ON uc.UsuarioID = usa.UsuarioID ORDER BY a.nombre, usa.UsuarioID

queries.name: official_mapping_resolution_verdict
queries.sql: WITH ApiLocal AS (SELECT id, nombre, EmpresaID FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones WHERE tipo_conexion = 'API_LOCAL' AND EmpresaID IS NULL), EmpresaServidor AS (SELECT a.id, COUNT(ses.EmpresaServidorID) AS empresa_servidor_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ses.EmpresaID) AS empresa_servidor_distinct_empresas, MIN(ses.EmpresaID) AS empresa_servidor_candidate FROM ApiLocal AS a LEFT JOIN dbo.Sistema_EmpresasServidores AS ses ON LOWER(CONVERT(nvarchar(100), ses.ServidorID)) = LOWER(CONVERT(nvarchar(100), a.id)) AND ISNULL(ses.Activo, 1) = 1 GROUP BY a.id), UnidadLinks AS (SELECT a.id, COUNT(u.id) AS unidad_link_count FROM ApiLocal AS a LEFT JOIN dbo.Unidades_Negocio AS u ON LOWER(CONVERT(nvarchar(100), u.server_id)) = LOWER(CONVERT(nvarchar(100), a.id)) AND ISNULL(u.activo, 0) = 1 GROUP BY a.id) SELECT a.nombre, CONVERT(nvarchar(100), a.id) AS connection_id, es.empresa_servidor_count, es.empresa_servidor_distinct_empresas, es.empresa_servidor_candidate, ul.unidad_link_count, CASE WHEN es.empresa_servidor_distinct_empresas = 1 THEN 'OFFICIAL_EMPRESA_SERVIDOR_MAPPING_FOUND' WHEN es.empresa_servidor_distinct_empresas > 1 THEN 'AMBIGUOUS_EMPRESA_SERVIDOR_MAPPING' WHEN ISNULL(ul.unidad_link_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'UNIT_LINK_FOUND_BUT_NO_EMPRESA_MAPPING' ELSE 'NO_OFFICIAL_MAPPING_FOUND' END AS official_mapping_verdict FROM ApiLocal AS a LEFT JOIN EmpresaServidor AS es ON es.id = a.id LEFT JOIN UnidadLinks AS ul ON ul.id = a.id ORDER BY official_mapping_verdict, a.nombre

objective: Find official canonical mapping sources for API_LOCAL connections that still have Servidores_Conexiones.EmpresaID NULL. Do not mutate SQL. Distinguish official relations from non-authoritative name hints.
